manifest.extDesc: Boost Notion productivity with 20+ customizations like outline, small text full width for all, back to top button etc

popup.chatGptWriterDesc: - Let AI write emails and messages for you

about.subtitle: Make Notion more productive and less distractive

displayOutline.name: Show Outline
displayOutline.desc: Show sticky outline (table of contents) for pages that have headings

hideTableOfContents.name: Hide Table of contents
hideTableOfContents.desc: Hide Notion's default 'Table of contents' feature

hideAiBtn.name: Hide AI button from pages
hideAiBtn.desc: Hide floating AI button (bottom-right corner) from pages

disableAiAfterSpaceKey.name: Disable AI menu when pressing space
disableAiAfterSpaceKey.desc: Don't show AI command menu when pressing space key

fullWidth.name: Full width for all pages
fullWidth.desc: Set full width for all pages by default

smallText.name: Small text for all pages
smallText.desc: Set small text for all pages by default

leftAlignMedia.name: Left align media
leftAlignMedia.desc: Align document images and videos to the left instead of center

addMoreHeightToPage.name: Add more height to page
addMoreHeightToPage.desc: Add more height to page by hiding top padding, image cover, & icon

openFullPage.name: Open full page instead of preview
openFullPage.desc: Bypass preview and open full page of table, board, etc

rollupUrlClickable.name: Make Rollup URLs clickable
rollupUrlClickable.desc: Make URLs in Rollup property clickable

scrollTopBtn.name: 'Scroll to top' button
scrollTopBtn.desc: Add button at bottom-right corner for scrolling back to top

hideSlashMenuAfterSpace.name: Close slash command menu after space
hideSlashMenuAfterSpace.desc: Close slash command popup menu '/' by pressing space key

disableSlashMenu.name: Don't show slash command menu when pressing '/'
disableSlashMenu.desc: Don't show slash command popup menu when pressing '/'

showHoverText.name: Show full text on hover
showHoverText.desc: Show full text in table cells on mouse hover

codeLineNumbers.name: Show code line numbers
codeLineNumbers.desc: Show line numbers for code blocks

spellcheckForCode.name: Enable spellcheck inside code blocks
spellcheckForCode.desc: Show squiggly red lines for any spelling mistakes inside code blocks

disablePopupOnURLPaste.name: Don't show popup menu when pasting external links
disablePopupOnURLPaste.desc: Don't show popup menu (i.e. dismiss, create bookmark, create embed) when pasting external URLs

hideNotification.name: Hide notification icon
hideNotification.desc: Hide red notification icon from sidebar when it's in closed state and hide notification number from tab title

narrowListItems.name: Narrow spacing between items
narrowListItems.desc: Fit more content on screen by reducing space between items i.e. headings, lists, etc.

indentationLines.name: Add indentation lines to lists
indentationLines.desc: Add vertical indentation lines to bullet and to-do lists

bolderTextInDark.name: Bolder text in dark mode
bolderTextInDark.desc: Fix poorly recognizable bold text in dark mode

hideHiddenColumns.name: Hide 'Hidden columns' in board view
hideHiddenColumns.desc: Truly hide 'Hidden columns' in Kanban board view

hideComments.name: Hide comments section from all pages

hideBacklinks.name: Hide backlinks section from all pages

borderOnImages.name: Add frame to images
borderOnImages.desc: Add frame around images to make them easily noticeable on page
